newsitem.title: USA: US Feb wholesale inventories rev to up 0.2 pct.
newsitem.headline: US Feb wholesale inventories rev to up 0.2 pct.

text.p: Commerce Department annual revisions to U.S. wholesale inventories and sales, seasonally adjusted.
Following are revisions for February 1997 and January 1997, seasonally adjusted, in percent changes and billions of dollars.
Year-ago comparisons for February are also included.

The February stock-to-sales ratio for merchant wholesalers, seasonally adjusted, fell to a revised 1.22 months' worth from a revised 1.24 months' worth in January. Previously the department reported the February stock-to-sales ratio at 1.24 months and the January ratio at 1.27 months.
The ratio is a measure of how many months it would take to sell existing inventories at the current sales pace.
The department reported initial data on February wholesale inventories and sales on April 8.

The department on Tuesday reported annual revisions to wholesale inventories for the period January 1995 through February 1997. It reported wholesale sales and stock/sales ratios for the period January 1994 through February 1997.
